quest_coverage_matrix.mechanics: Age and needs in hover text; sneak + empty-hand right-click reports age/status. Sheep, goats, pigs, chickens and vanilla wolves have direct patches; optional mod species are conditional, not proof of installed animals.
quest_coverage_matrix.better_husbandry: BH displays bloodline/trust separately and writes effective vanilla generation; do not equate bloodline with age or LW health.

quest_coverage_matrix.mechanics: Remove Natural Fertilizer droppings, LW muck/dog poop and ground-stored rot. Dirt moves filth toward environmental dirt exponentially; it is not a fixed daily filth increase. Kept adults can deposit muck; chicks/nursed babies are kept clean. IsKept means generation >= Hygiene.MuckMinGeneration (1), origin=playerplaced, or a nonempty Pet AI owner; it is not synonymous with any nearby wild animal.
quest_coverage_matrix.better_husbandry: LW IsKept and muck generation checks read vanilla generation, which BH recomputes from bloodline + floating care modifiers summed then truncated to integer; care can change eligibility without a new birth.

quest_coverage_matrix.mechanics: Dry grass or grooming brush; hold right-click on groomable adults. Grooming removes 0.25 filth per completed use, not disease directly. Chickens self-clean; nursed babies do not need brushing. Shovels harmless to supported animals (shove instead of damage).
quest_coverage_matrix.better_husbandry: LW grooming is not BH RegisterInteract: BH patches petting, milking and optional shearing. Do not promise brushing awards BH trust.

quest_coverage_matrix.quest: Recognize, isolate and support a sick animal
quest_coverage_matrix.mechanics: Daily illness probability = .25*(filth² + weatherStress²), doubled when old. Same-species contagion within radius 3. Recovery daily chance = .35*(1-filth)*(1-weatherStress), then 6-day immunity. Sick animals lose normal regeneration and breeding; kept sick animals take damage and may collapse. Cleaning/shelter improve odds, not an instant medicine cure. HarmPerDay/SickDamagePerDay are normalized to 17 reference max-health and scale to the animal max-health, not fixed absolute HP across species.
quest_coverage_matrix.better_husbandry: High BH effective generation/trust is not immunity and does not bypass LW sickness, damage or LW breeding cooldown blocks.

quest_coverage_matrix.quest: Provide a roof and a tolerable climate
quest_coverage_matrix.mechanics: Rain/snow, temperature and sleeping outside build stress. Animals seek shelter, may get heat-listless/lose appetite; extreme stress harms kept animals, illness risk rises, breeding can stop. Petting reduces LW weather stress with its own cooldown. HarmPerDay/SickDamagePerDay are normalized to 17 reference max-health and scale to the animal max-health, not fixed absolute HP across species.
quest_coverage_matrix.better_husbandry: BH petting and LW stress relief coexist but have distinct timers/effects. Food condition and trust do not replace a roof.

quest_coverage_matrix.mechanics: Walk to fresh natural water or consume water from supported placed containers/waterer. Natural water is free; container volume is consumed. Salt/boiling/tainted water is not universally drinkable. A thirsty animal cannot be fixed just by feeding. HarmPerDay/SickDamagePerDay are normalized to 17 reference max-health and scale to the animal max-health, not fixed absolute HP across species.
quest_coverage_matrix.better_husbandry: BH feed-care scoring is not thirst. LW thirst breeding/regen/damage penalties remain active.

quest_coverage_matrix.mechanics: Keep nursing babies near a suitable female. Mother health/stress affects milk; sick mothers can infect young. Nourishment can slow growth or cause harm. Babies learn trough feeding after time with mother; chicks follow a hen rather than needing mammalian milk. HarmPerDay/SickDamagePerDay are normalized to 17 reference max-health and scale to the animal max-health, not fixed absolute HP across species.
quest_coverage_matrix.better_husbandry: Breeding.Enabled=false does NOT disable LW baby nourishment/growth penalties. BH care bonuses are not a replacement for nursing.

quest_coverage_matrix.quest: Hand-feed an orphan / teach the trough
quest_coverage_matrix.mechanics: Use supported milk/food on a nursing baby; three hand-feedings teach trough use. Babies are excluded from ordinary chicken treat setup. Keep orphan care separate from adult feeding.
quest_coverage_matrix.better_husbandry: No direct BH ownership conflict found; full-pack runtime not tested.

quest_coverage_matrix.mechanics: Daytime chickens seek dry sand within 10 blocks, with air above and no rain falling on the sand. Bath when filth >= .1 or 20 hours since last bath; 12-second bath resets filth to zero. After 2 unbathed days environmental target is at least .5. Chickens are not brush targets.
quest_coverage_matrix.better_husbandry: A tame/trusting chicken still needs dust-bathing access. SelfCleaningHours is the fallback when DustBathing=false, not the active bath interval.

quest_coverage_matrix.mechanics: Hold food matching the chicken creatureDiet to lure it; hand feeding consumes one item, adds 1 hunger saturation and updates lastMealEatenTotalHours, with one-hour cooldown. Not an all-species LW lure.
quest_coverage_matrix.better_husbandry: Treats can contribute to feeding/breeding state and BH last-fed data, but do not call BH RegisterInteract. Do not claim a direct BH trust bonus for each grain.

quest_coverage_matrix.mechanics: LW coop kit places ordinary blocks: raised 5×5 coop, ramps 2 long, two hen boxes, rear gate. Recipe uses eight ingredient cells ×8 planks =64 planks plus two hen boxes. It is a building shortcut, not a new egg machine or required structure; hand-built coops work.
quest_coverage_matrix.better_husbandry: No BH timer replacement is provided by the coop; egg/breeding conditions remain those of actual entity behaviors.

quest_coverage_matrix.mechanics: Lifespans randomized in game-calendar years; old at 75% of personal lifespan. Old animals infertile; old-age death enabled. Read age rather than treating effective generation as biological age. Pre-existing/wild adults get an assumed starting age in the first half of life; babies retain birth-age across grow-up. Do not promise historical birth dates for imported adults.
quest_coverage_matrix.better_husbandry: BH generation changes do not rejuvenate LW birth date or erase old-age infertility.

quest_coverage_matrix.quest: Breed healthy animals without inventing LW timings
quest_coverage_matrix.mechanics: LW runtime rewriting of portions, pregnancy, rest and grow-up timings is disabled. Retained numbers are dormant presets, NOT effective pack breeding rates. LW sickness/age/weather/thirst can still hold breeding cooldown ahead of the current time.

config.dormant_species_presets: Full exact values in JSON config; sheep/goat 10 portions,20 pregnancy days,4–11 rest,14 grow; pig 10,25,6–11,7; chicken 4,null,0–3,8.3.

quest_coverage_matrix.better_husbandry: BH effective generation still participates in base-game generation-dependent behavior; BH does not itself make the dormant LW timing overrides active.

quest_coverage_matrix.quest: Use clean bedding for kept mammal mating
quest_coverage_matrix.mechanics: IMPORTANT: RequireBedding is true and the bedding Settings getter does not test Breeding.Enabled. Kept females with vanilla multiply must mate on clean straw bedding; 15-second mating, search radius16. Birth soils LW bedding and mother/newborn stay there for 1 day. Therefore disabling the timing rewrite does NOT disable bedding requirement.
quest_coverage_matrix.better_husbandry: BH recomputed vanilla generation can change LW IsKept and therefore whether bedding gate applies. Hens use multiplybase, not this EntityBehaviorMultiply pregnancy gate; do not teach straw bedding as a hen egg requirement.

quest_coverage_matrix.quest: Maintain BH care and effective generation
quest_coverage_matrix.mechanics: BH stores bloodline separately; effective vanilla generation = int(max(0, bloodline + feed modifier + interaction modifier)), i.e. truncation after summing, NOT separate rounding. Feed and interaction modifiers each bounded -3..3. Daily good care +.03, decay .2, condition thresholds .95/.75; interaction grace1 day, generation decay multiplier .5, interaction memory30 days. Offline protection early-returns the entire BH daily update when recorded recent interactors are all offline and its protection check passes; it does not suspend LW needs. Feed condition thresholds .95/.75 are actually hardcoded in BH ApplyFeedAxis (retained config happens to match), not read from those threshold config fields.
quest_coverage_matrix.better_husbandry: Pet after at least .6s, milking, optional ShearLib DoShear register BH interactions. Keep bloodline and temporary effective generation explicit.

quest_coverage_matrix.mechanics: All six LW lethal permissions are enabled and PauseWhenNoPlayerNearby=false. Do not promise offline invulnerability from BH config. Loaded simulated animals can age, become ill, thirst or starve; individual LW needs cap catch-up, which is not global suspension.
quest_coverage_matrix.better_husbandry: BH offlineFullProtect=true does not govern LW safety. PlayerRadius64 is inactive while pause flag is false.

quest_coverage_matrix.mechanics: Dogs.Enabled=true; kept vanilla wolves get LW dog care. Bond .5 initial,+.1 pet (2h cooldown),-.08/day without company; lonely below .25, loyal above .75; guard herd/garden, bark, help hunts, spare kept animals/players, lure pups. Dog bowls craftable. External companion trips/commands/beds need the actual external provider and are not proven available here.
quest_coverage_matrix.better_husbandry: BH is not Pet AI or Feral Kinship Companions. Those IDs must not be conflated; none of petai, wolftaming, feralkinship, feralkinshipcompanions are enabled in this retained export.

limitations: Static source and exact supplied-DLL decompilation, not a launched full-pack server.
Client export does not prove server-deployed config, world settings, behavior merge success or runtime patch order.
Genelib present: LW defers dirty-coat replacement if another texture source already owns appearance; absence of visible dirt is not evidence of disabled hygiene.
Catch Livestock is an independent installed capture provider, not Pet AI/Feral Kinship; its capture controls were not audited in this LW/BH task.
No hard LW/BH mutual disable, missing companion dependency or automatic BH-driven LW toggle found; this is not blanket runtime compatibility certification.
